::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(tidynorm)
library(tidybayes)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
speaker_tracks |> 
  norm_track_nearey(
    F1:F3,
    .by = speaker,
    .token_id_col = id,
    .time_col = t,
    .return_dct = TRUE
  ) ->
  normed_dct
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
normed_dct |>
  select(
    -(F1:F3)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = .param,
    values_from = F1_lm:F3_lm
  ) ->
  dct_wide
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bform <- bf(
    mvbind(F1_lm_0, F1_lm_1, F1_lm_2, F2_lm_0, F2_lm_1, F2_lm_2) ~ (1|p|plt_vclass)
  ) +
  set_rescor(TRUE)

brm(
  bform,
  data = dct_wide,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  file = "models/vowel",
  cores = 4
) ->
  model
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
model |>
  gather_draws(
    `cor_.*`,
    regex = T
  ) ->
  cors

model |>
  gather_draws(
    `sd_.*`,
    regex = T
  ) ->
  sds
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cors |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    X = str_extract(
      .variable, 
      ".*?(F\\dlm\\d).*?(F\\dlm\\d).*",
      group = 1
    ),
    Y = str_extract(
      .variable, 
      ".*?(F\\dlm\\d).*?(F\\dlm\\d).*",
      group = 2
    )    
  ) |>
  select(
    -c(.variable, .chain, .iteration)
  ) |>
  rename(cor = .value) ->
  cors_df

sds |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    param = str_extract(
      .variable,
      "F\\dlm\\d"
    )
  ) |> 
  select(
    -c(.variable, .chain, .iteration)
  ) |>
  rename(
    sd = .value
  ) ->
  sd_df
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
cors_df |>
  left_join(
    sd_df,
    by = join_by(X == param, .draw == .draw)
  ) |>
  left_join(
    sd_df,
    by = join_by(Y == param, .draw == .draw)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    cov = cor * sd.x * sd.y
  ) |>
  select(
    -c(cor, sd.x, sd.y)
  ) ->
  cov_upper

cov_upper |> 
  mutate(
    X0 = X,
    X = Y,
    Y = X0
  ) |>
  select(
    -X0
  ) ->
  cov_lower

sd_df |>
  mutate(
    cov = sd ^ 2,
    X = param,
    Y = param
  ) |>
  select(
    -c(sd, param)
  ) ->
  cov_diag
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bind_rows(
  cov_upper,
  cov_lower,
  cov_diag
) |>
  arrange(
    X, Y
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = X,
    values_from = cov
  ) |>
  select(
    -Y
  ) |>
  nest(
    .by = .draw
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    mat = map(
      data,
      as.matrix
    ) ,
    eigens = map(
      mat,
      eigen
    ),
    eigen_v = map(
      eigens,
      ~.x$vector
    )
  ) ->
  eigen_df
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
model |>
  gather_draws(
    `r_.*`,
    regex = T
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    param = str_extract(
      .variable,
      "F\\dlm\\d"
    ),
    vowel = str_extract(
      .variable,
      "\\[(.*?),",
      group = 1
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    -c(.variable, .chain, .iteration)
  ) |>
  arrange(
    param
  ) |>
  summarise(
    .by = c(.draw, vowel),
    .value = list(.value)
  ) ->
  vowel_values
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vowel_values |>
  left_join(
    eigen_df
  ) |>
  mutate(
    scores = map2(
      .value, eigen_v,
      ~.x %*% .y
    ),
    scores = map(scores, as_tibble)
  ) |>
  select(.draw, vowel, scores) |>
  unnest(scores) ->
  pca_scores
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pca_scores |>
  filter(
    vowel == "iy"
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(V1, V2)
  ) +
  geom_point()
```
